figures.finding: Dominica has no licence or exception for a child performer: no one may employ a child under twelve in any occupation whatever, save light domestic or farm work at home for the parents; under fourteen a child may not work in an industrial undertaking or on a ship save a family one, and under eighteen not at night in industry. From twelve no performer-specific hours, schooling or chaperone rule was found. The bar is on employment of any kind, so it reaches a young writer or director as well.

value.under12: barred from any occupation (family light domestic/agricultural work excepted)

figures.applies: The 1990 revised laws; later labour legislation not found on the government site (see blockers).

sources.said: AN ACT to prohibit the employment of children in any occupation … "child" means a person who in the opinion of the Court, in a prosecution for an offence against this Act, is under the age of twelve years; … domestic work or agricultural work of a light nature at home by the parents or guardian of the child.
"child" means a person under the age of fourteen years; … "young person" means a person who has ceased to be a child and who is under the age of eighteen years.

figures.finding: An infant is a person under eighteen, and full age at eighteen applies to every rule of law and instrument; how a minor's contract for creative work is made binding and any set-aside of earnings weren't found.

sources.said: In this Act "infant" means a person under the age of eighteen … (2) The provisions of subsection (1) applies for the purposes of any rule or law, and for the construction of the expressions "full age", "infant", "infancy", "minor", "minority"
